records.claim: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) recommends that nirmatrelvir/ritonavir not be withheld from women who are pregnant and have COVID-19 if they otherwise qualify to receive this medication. The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) states that nirmatrelvir/ritonavir is the preferred treatment for women who are pregnant and have COVID-19 that does not require hospitalization. If you have COVID-19, your healthcare providers can talk with you about what treatment is best for you.
